sloka: चक्षुर्विषयमागम्य नायं जीवितुमर्हति ।दृष्टिं दृष्टिविषस्येव सर्पस्य मम रावणः ।। ६.१०१.५४ ।।
transliteration: cakṣurviṣayamāgamya nāyaṁ jīvitumarhati ।dṛṣṭiṁ dṛṣṭiviṣasyeva sarpasya mama rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.101.54 ।।

translations.english: 'Let the three worlds, with the gandharvas and the gods, with the rishis and charanas, behold this day upon the field what it is that makes Rama Rama.'
